POORLY mediocre
Apr 2018
Go there only if you'r crazy hungry and want to make out on the "quantity" of the dishes for the money paid. 
But do NOT stop in this spot if you'r looking for the quality. Overall the food doesn't look fresh, most is pretty dry and not tasty. The only I'd save can be the salmon which was okay yet I guess that same kind of fresh salmon is not difficult to pick at any closest Mart, in a seafood city like this. The tuna instead, was sadly grey colour. Octopus and frogs totally not chewable, like rubber. This is what dejected me from trying the meats & skewers. Baked oysters- you have hard time to find one on the depths of that anonymous cream spread with which is filled the shell, as they're extremely small.
Not any noodle dishes. Strange, as noodles do not cost nothing, so such a place which points to do economy could at least offer 2-3 good fried noodle options. There was only some tomato spaghetti which I didn't try.
The most of waiters, when you ask something in english only use to say "no", but likely because they just don't want to get in trouble(?). So the advice is: don't care of that, they will say "no" regardlessly what you ask. (yet I frankly do not lower the rating out of this, the rating is exclusively on the food quality- for the rest, they're vietnamese people living in their country, have the right to not speak english. as this is not even a hotel, only a restaurant)
Plus, the ugliest thing was the table cloth - what a pity I forgot to take a pic. As right in the middle there was a wearing-out hole, and other smaller burn-holes along the border.(not sure from where such holes come, as I didn't realize there was a smoking area, but probably from the times there was one(?).
And, if you use their wet hand wipe(the one in airtight silver paper, which you find on the table near to the fork), you will be charged extra 3000 VND, -and there's no other kind of(paper) towels around, so just bring & use your own tissues.
I guess that says it quite all.

Hot Food served cold ruined the experience
Nov 2017 • Couples
Very disappointing evening - 8pm arrival. 2 meals pictured here were totally cold. The manager offered to heat my food and was genuinely apologetic. Instead we agreed on stopping there, with no charge and a complementary bowl of ice-cream. This experience was a supreme disappointment - especially given the lovely interior architecture. Many staff also seemed to be chatting with each other and laughing between themselves in the dining room, instead of caring that serving utensils were safe (some fallen in foods - yuck and dangerous) and tables cleared. I also felt ill to observe some questionable food handling practices (chefs touching own hair and face then immediately touching foods near the soup area). All this ruined the experience - with stale prawn cakes too. There are many other great options across Da Nang, so avoid SOHO until ratings show they take food safety and serving temperature seriously.
